mapper.select: select tpp.id as id,tpp.procurement_plan_name as procurementPlanName,tpp.procurement_plan_code as procurementPlanCode from tb_procurement_plan tpp left join tb_procurement_scheme_plan_relate tpr on tpr.procurement_plan_id = tpp.id where tpr.procurement_scheme_id = #{schemeId,jdbcType=BIGINT} order by tpp.create_time desc

select tps.id as schemeId,tps.procurement_scheme_code as procurementSchemeCode,tps.procurement_scheme_name as procurementSchemeName, tps.procurement_plan_type as procurementPlanType from tb_procurement_scheme tps inner join tb_tender_notice tn on tps.id = tn.scheme_id and tn.notice_status = 8
tps.id in ( select tpr.procurement_scheme_id from tb_procurement_scheme_plan_relate tpr inner join tb_contract_planning_split tps on tps.id = tpr.contract_split_id where tps.is_use_up = 1 ) and tps.project_code = #{queryVO.projectCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and tps.procurement_scheme_name like concat('%',#{queryVO.procurementSchemeName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
and tps.procurement_scheme_code like concat('%',#{queryVO.procurementSchemeCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
order by tps.create_time desc

select distinct tps.id, tcp.project_name minAccountFullName, tcp.project_code,tpspr.create_time as crTime from tb_procurement_scheme tps left join tb_procurement_scheme_plan_relate tpspr on tpspr.procurement_scheme_id = tps.id left join tb_contract_planning tcp on tcp.plan_id = tpspr.procurement_plan_id
where tps.id = #{schemeId, jdbcType=BIGINT} order by crTime desc
